title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia with Trump's backing after a leadership crisis and personal scandals
summary: The Nvidia CEO returns to his post amid intense political and corporate turbulence that has shaken the company's stock market value.

title: TIDAL announces the removal of 29 million AI-generated songs
summary: The music platform takes drastic measures to combat the saturation of automated content in its catalog.

title: Anthropic introduces Claude Ship for AI agents to autonomously review and approve code
summary: The new tool aims to streamline software development by allowing artificial intelligence to manage its own pull requests.

title: Rockstar Games halts reverse engineering projects and unofficial GTA VI PC ports
summary: The company has taken down Discord servers and GitHub repositories linked to community initiatives to recreate the game on computers.

title: Samsung launches the Odyssey G60H gaming monitor with a record 1,100 Hz refresh rate
summary: The new panel reaches unprecedented figures while limiting its maximum resolution to achieve such performance.

title: Z.ai and the Chinese giant introduce the new GLM-5.4 model to compete with OpenAI and Google
summary: The new artificial intelligence promises performance comparable to much larger models through the efficient reuse of its neural layers.

title: Japan deploys mobile semiconductor manufacturing labs inside trucks
summary: This initiative seeks to decentralize and make chip production more flexible in the face of future sector challenges.

title: The Ladybird web browser enters alpha phase and launches its first public downloads
summary: The independent alternative not based on traditional engines is now available for macOS and Linux users.

title: Meta integrates its Muse artificial intelligence assistant directly into Instagram direct messages
summary: The tool will allow users to manage plans and saved content by chatting directly within the social platform.

title: ASRock and Intel present a Mini PC with Panther Lake designed for educational and industrial robotics
summary: A compact solution tailored for specialized automation tasks.
